findings.text: The newly added comment block ends '...would put an image's verdict somewhere the plan's design does not place it', a plan-document reference in source that the naming rule forbids in comments and docstrings. The reason belongs in the plan; the comment should state the mechanism (the two files live inside the image so that removing the image removes them together).

The assertion's expected reason is the literal the test itself handed to _record_import_verdict at line 230, and the whole test at :222-242 passes unchanged against the pre-change implementation, where the blocking flock at the old reckon/checkout_trust.py:884 acquires only after the writer closes and then reads the recorded verdict. It therefore records the pre-existing read-after-wait behaviour and does not guard the bounded-wait change it was added beside; the discriminating check for that is the held-lock test at :201-219.
